topics.title: 课程作业与考核规范
topics.summary: 学生不应将生成式AI用于课程作业的准备或生成，除非经由模块协调员明确授权。
topics.evidenceScope: Learning and Teaching Committee student guidance

claims.text: Generative AI should not be used for coursework unless explicitly authorised by the module coordinator.

evidence.quote:
Students should not use Generative AI for the preparation and presentation of assessed
  work unless authorised explicitly by the module co-ordinator.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students
evidence.location: Section 4. Can Students use AI to produce assessed work?

topics.title: 考试与考场纪律
topics.summary: 《良好学术实践政策》规定，未经授权使用AI属于学术不端的一种。
topics.scope: 良好学术行为守则考核标准
topics.evidenceScope: Good Academic Practice Policy assessment standards

claims.text: The Good Academic Practice Policy states that unauthorized use of AI is a type of academic misconduct.

evidence.quote:
The Good Academic Practice Policy states that Unauthorised use of AI is a type of
academic misconduct.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students
evidence.location: Section 5. How does Good Academic Practice address AI?

topics.title: AI使用声明与封面
topics.summary: 当允许并使用生成式AI时，学生应在提交的作业中明确声明；强制要求引用所有完整提示词属于未核实缺口。
topics.scope: 作业提交声明要求（原始提示词强制引用未核实）
topics.evidenceScope: Submitted work declaration (raw prompt citation unverified)

claims.text: Where generative AI is permitted and used, this should be clearly declared in submitted work.

evidence.quote:
If AI has been used, this should be clearly declared by the student on an assessment
  coversheet.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students

topics.title: 隐私与数据保护
topics.summary: 学生指引提示AI可能收集提示词数据，并强调不要向AI工具提交个人或敏感信息。
topics.scope: 校级数据保护与防泄漏规范

claims.text: Student guidance warns that AI may capture prompt data and says it is important not to submit personal or sensitive information to an AI tool.

evidence.quote:
AI may capture data from input prompts, so it is important not to submit personal or
    sensitive information to an AI tool.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students
evidence.location: Section 5. Data protection and input prompts caution

topics.title: 认可与支持的AI工具
topics.summary: 学校为所有拥有@st-andrews.ac.uk邮箱的在校师生提供官方统一授权的Microsoft Copilot工具。

claims.text: The university provides Microsoft Copilot to all staff and students with commercial data protection services enabled.

evidence.quote:
The University’s provided AI tool is Microsoft Copilot. This is available to all staff and
    students, with ‘Commercial Data Protection’ services enabled.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students
evidence.location: Section 2. How can I access AI tools?

topics.title: 科研与论文署名
topics.summary: 考虑使用生成式AI的研究型研究生应在使用前与导师讨论并商定适当的使用范围、界限及用途。
topics.scope: 研究生科研导师协议规范

claims.text: Postgraduate researchers considering generative AI should discuss and agree appropriate scope, boundaries, and applications with their supervisor before use.

evidence.quote:
PGR students considering the use of Generative AI should discuss and agree appropriate
  scope, boundaries, and applications with their supervisor at the start of the project or before
  commencing usage.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students
evidence.location: Section 15. What should PGR students consider before using AI?

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信与违规处理
additionalTopics.statusLabel: 良好学术行为守则追责
additionalTopics.summary: 未经注明来源，将AI技术产出作为自己的作品提交，属于学术不端。
additionalTopics.scope: 生成式AI学术不端认定定义
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Definition of academic misconduct regarding AI

claims.text: Presenting the output of an AI technology as one's own work without acknowledgment is treated as academic misconduct under university policy.

evidence.quote:
Using AI is considered academic misconduct when a student presents the output of an AI
  technology, such as a large language model (LLM) or paraphrasing application, as their
  own work without acknowledgment
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students
evidence.location: Section 5. Definition of academic misconduct regarding AI

additionalTopics.title: 教学实践原则
additionalTopics.summary: 学生指引建议，只有在模块协调员允许时才在考核中使用AI。
additionalTopics.scope: 课程协调员模块手册指导原则

claims.text: The student guidance says students should use AI in assessment only when the module coordinator permits it.

evidence.quote:
You should only use AI for assessment when you are permitted to by the module co-
ordinator.
evidence.title: Generative AI – FAQs for students

additionalTopics.title: 安全合规与采购
